explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares CHATS-CRITIC (which uses LLM as judge) against human ratings on the same set of chart summaries, reporting correlation metrics and statistical significance

prompts.notes: Prompt uses Chain-of-thought with 2-shot examples for entailment verification. Full prompt shown in Appendix A.4.4 with reasoning examples.

guidelines.notes: Detailed annotation guidelines provided in Appendix B.2 with specific criteria for entailment, relevance, and grammaticality, including examples of acceptable approximations.

sample_size.notes: 60 charts randomly sampled from Chart-To-Text (Statista) test set, with sentences annotated by both human raters and CHATS-CRITIC

quantitative_scores.notes: Moderate correlation for PALM-2 annotation set
Reference set compared to baseline of 75.0
Reference set compared to baseline of 50.0

validation_results.summary_finding: CHATS-CRITIC using PaLM-2 shows moderate to strong correlation (Pearson: 43.6-62.2) with human ratings, significantly outperforming reference-based metrics and achieving statistical significance (p<0.001).

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM focuses primarily on entailment/faithfulness verification, while human evaluators also assess relevance and grammatical quality.
